items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: I think it was right after Bill died

ctx.x: and Sonny Greer on drums and I forgot the name of the piano player, I forgot the trumpet player, but I had those people to make a combination. And I was entertaining in this club and he saw it billed and he's in Germany. He's booking acts for Special Service. After he sees me he says if I was over there I could go in a picture. He writes me a letter and tells me. I don't know who he is. I just think he's another agent. If I'm over there, I could go in a picture. And he wanted to know if I'd come and he stated the…

So I thought that would be good. I'd only be gone a week, 10 days at the most. I'll go and come back. And I went in 1945 -- I think it was right after Bill died, 1951 or '52 -- 1952, '53. it took five years to come back. I come back in 1950 something -- '57 I came back. I went over there --
This isn't the period when Buck was in jail?
